facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/wobj:HSD_WObjInterpretAnim
facts.existing_value: A NULL WObj is an immediate no-op. For a non-NULL WObj, its own AObj is always processed before its attached RObj list. A missing or stopped WObj AObj is a local no-op inside HSD_AObjInterpretAnim and does not prevent RObj animation from running. Active spline channels clamp their parameter to 0 through 1 and mark the resulting position as spline-relative; each RObj controller is then processed independently, so an inactive controller on one relation does not stop traversal of later relations.
